The ShapeShift swapper feature aggregates quotes from multiple DEX aggregators and bridge protocols for same-chain and cross-chain swaps.
ShapeShift’s swap interface was described as distinguishing same-chain from cross-chain swaps, displaying gas costs, price impact and exchange rates, offering multiple swappers with best-rate sorting, showing minimums and helpful errors, and providing loading states.
